plan: Represent the working recipe as a deep copy of the authored one; print_original returns authored_text verbatim so the original is always reproducible byte-for-byte.
Scale first: compute a single Fraction factor target_yield/yield and multiply every quantity in the main ingredient list and every component ingredient list.

Process each ingredient list as a growable worklist: while an ingredient's name is excluded, select the catalog choice by the (priority, catalog-index) key and apply it atomically across name, quantity, unit, preparation, instruction wording, and equipment.
Detect cycles with a per-ingredient-slot seen-set of names; emit 'substitution cycle involving NAME' when a replacement repeats.

Append additional ingredients from a result to the same worklist (scaled by the current yield factor) so they undergo the same exclusion and catalog processing, enabling chained adaptations and detection of reintroduced exclusions (recorded as warnings).

Accumulate reasons in a set and keep going after each failure so every independently applicable reason is collected; after substitution, sort the equipment and check containment in available_equipment, adding 'equipment NAME unavailable' per missing item.
Return {possible, recipe, choices, warnings, reasons} with recipe null and sorted deduplicated reasons when impossible, sorted warnings always, and choices in application order.

Verify with an executable __main__ acceptance block covering 3→5 scaling, chained substitution, verb+equipment change, reintroduced exclusion, multiple simultaneous reasons, exact original print, priority determinism, and input immutability.
mechanisms: deep-copied working recipe with authored_text returned verbatim (original never mutated)
uniform Fraction scaling factor target_yield/yield applied to all ingredient lists
deterministic choice selection by (numeric priority, catalog index) key
per-slot chained substitution loop with seen-set cycle detection
atomic cross-field application of one choice: name, quantity_factor, unit, preparation, wording_changes, equipment add/remove, yield compensation
global wording rewrite of old/new pairs over every instruction list
worklist append of additional ingredients so they re-enter exclusion/catalog processing
reason accumulation set that continues past failures, then sorted/deduplicated
post-pass sorted-equipment subset check against available_equipment
warning set for reintroduced exclusions and yield rescaling

trace.source_relation: original preserved: the arranger keeps the original score untouched while working on structured copies
trace.target_mechanism: adapt deep-copies the recipe before any change and print_original returns authored_text verbatim, so the authored recipe stays printable byte-for-byte

trace.source_relation: cross field consistency: one instrument substitution updates every linked cue, range, seating, and balance marking together
trace.target_mechanism: each catalog choice is applied atomically across name, quantity factor, unit, preparation, instruction wording, and equipment in a single step

trace.source_relation: chained replacement: one substitution may trigger another replacement
trace.target_mechanism: the per-ingredient loop re-checks the replacement name against exclusions and keeps substituting, with a seen-set that turns repeats into 'substitution cycle involving NAME'

trace.source_relation: post step constraint check: results are checked against ensemble availability rules after substitutions
trace.target_mechanism: after all substitutions, the merged equipment set is sorted and checked for containment in available_equipment, emitting one 'equipment NAME unavailable' reason per missing item

trace.source_relation: deterministic priority: prioritized substitution list resolves competing options
trace.target_mechanism: choice selection uses the key (numeric priority, catalog index) so lower priority wins and catalog order breaks ties

trace.source_relation: ordered global rewrites: a chosen substitution rewrites all linked cues across the score
trace.target_mechanism: wording_changes pairs are applied as global old-to-new rewrites over every instruction list, in choice-application order
